primitives.name: Custom Object Schema
primitives.verbatim_quote: Setup includes server, worker, Postgres, storage, SMTP, S3, OAuth, and recurring worker jobs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {o_i: custom object instance, I: index set of object types}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a fixed schema for each object type with pre-defined fields.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singular when schema evolution introduces breaking changes.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a relational database table structure where each row represents an instance of a custom object type.
